name: User Authentication System
description: Build a user authentication system for a web application. The system should allow users to sign up with email and password, log in, and log out. Passwords must be securely hashed. Include a 'forgot password' flow that sends a reset link via email. Add OAuth 2.0 login support for Google and GitHub. All endpoints should be RESTful and return proper HTTP status codes.
requirements: User signup with email and password
Forgot password with email reset link
constraints: Must use OAuth 2.0 standard
Passwords must be hashed using bcrypt
Must include unit tests for all auth endpoints
Backend API must be completed before frontend integration

name: E-Commerce Checkout Flow
description: Build a complete checkout flow for an online store. Users should be able to view their cart, enter shipping information, select a shipping method, enter payment details, review their order, and receive an order confirmation. The system must calculate taxes and shipping costs dynamically based on the user's location.
requirements: Shopping cart display with item list and totals
Shipping method selection with cost calculation
constraints: Must support credit card and PayPal payments
Shipping cost API must be integrated before checkout UI
Must handle edge cases like empty cart and invalid addresses
All forms must have client-side and server-side validation

name: Blog Platform with CMS
description: Create a blogging platform where authors can write, edit, and publish blog posts. The platform should have a simple content management system with a rich text editor. Readers should be able to browse posts, search by keywords, filter by categories, and leave comments. Include an admin dashboard showing basic analytics like page views and popular posts.
requirements: Blog post creation with rich text editor
Publish and draft status for posts
constraints: Rich text editor must support images and code blocks
Database schema must be designed before API development
Search must work without external search engines
Must include basic spam protection for comments

name: Real-Time Notification System
description: Build a notification system that supports multiple channels: in-app notifications, email notifications, and push notifications for mobile. The system must handle notification preferences per user, allowing them to opt in or out of specific notification types. Include a notification center UI where users can view, mark as read, and dismiss notifications. The system must support scheduling notifications for future delivery and handle retry logic for failed deliveries.
requirements: Notification center UI with read/unread status
Mark as read and dismiss functionality
Rate limiting to prevent notification spam
constraints: Must use WebSocket for real-time in-app notifications
Email service must be abstracted for provider switching
Push notifications require device token management
Backend notification service must be built before any channel integration
Must handle at least 1000 notifications per minute

name: File Management System
description: Build a cloud file management system similar to a simplified Google Drive. Users should be able to upload files, organize them in folders, share files with other users with different permission levels (view, edit, admin), and generate shareable links. Include file preview for common formats (images, PDFs, text files). The system must handle file versioning so users can see previous versions and restore them.
requirements: File sharing with permission levels (view, edit, admin)
Shareable link generation with optional expiry
File preview for images, PDFs, and text files
File search by name and type
Bulk operations (move, delete, download multiple files)
constraints: Files must be stored in cloud storage (S3 compatible)
File upload service must be completed before UI work
Must handle files up to 100MB
Permission system must be role-based
Must include virus scanning for uploaded files

name: API Rate Limiter and Gateway
description: Build an API gateway with intelligent rate limiting for a microservices architecture. The gateway should route requests to appropriate backend services, enforce rate limits per API key and per endpoint, cache frequent responses, and provide a dashboard showing API usage analytics. Include support for different rate limit tiers (free, basic, premium) and automatic throttling with informative error responses when limits are exceeded.
requirements: Multiple rate limit tiers (free, basic, premium)
Health check monitoring for backend services
constraints: Must use Redis for rate limit counters and caching
Rate limit logic must be implemented before routing
Must handle at least 10000 requests per second
Gateway must add less than 5ms latency
Must support both REST and GraphQL backends

name: Multi-Tenant SaaS Dashboard
description: Build a multi-tenant SaaS analytics dashboard where each tenant (company) has isolated data, custom branding, and role-based access control. The dashboard should display real-time metrics, historical charts, and exportable reports. Include a tenant onboarding flow, subscription management with different plan tiers, and an admin super-panel for managing all tenants. The system must handle tenant data isolation at the database level and support white-labeling with custom domains.
requirements: Multi-tenant data isolation at database level
Custom branding per tenant (logo, colors, domain)
Real-time metrics dashboard with live updates
Super admin panel for tenant management
constraints: Must use row-level security or schema-per-tenant for data isolation
Database architecture must be finalized before any feature development
Must support at least 100 concurrent tenants
White-label features require DNS and SSL automation
Real-time features must use WebSocket connections
Must comply with SOC 2 data handling requirements

name: CI/CD Pipeline with Automated Testing
description: Design and implement a complete CI/CD pipeline for a microservices application with 5 services. The pipeline must include automated unit testing, integration testing, security scanning, Docker image building, staging deployment, automated smoke tests on staging, and production deployment with blue-green strategy. Include rollback capabilities, deployment notifications, and a pipeline dashboard showing build status and deployment history for all services.
requirements: Automated unit test execution for all 5 services
Security vulnerability scanning (SAST and dependency scan)
Docker image building and registry push
Parallel pipeline execution for independent services
constraints: All services must pass tests before any deployment
Security scan must run before Docker build
Staging must be validated before production deployment
Blue-green deployment requires load balancer configuration
Must support both scheduled and triggered deployments
Pipeline must complete within 15 minutes for fast feedback
Must handle deployment dependencies between services

name: Real-Time Collaborative Document Editor
description: Build a real-time collaborative document editor where multiple users can edit the same document simultaneously, similar to Google Docs. The system must handle concurrent edits using operational transformation or CRDTs, show real-time cursors and selections of other users, support rich text formatting, document versioning with diff view, comments and suggestions, and export to multiple formats. Include user presence indicators and a document sharing system with granular permissions.
requirements: Real-time collaborative editing with conflict resolution
Concurrent edit handling using OT or CRDTs
Real-time cursor and selection display for all users
Rich text formatting (bold, italic, headings, lists, links)
Document version history with diff view
Export to PDF, DOCX, and Markdown
Offline editing with sync on reconnect
constraints: Must implement OT or CRDT algorithm for conflict resolution
Conflict resolution engine must be built before editor UI
Must handle at least 20 simultaneous editors per document
Real-time sync latency must be under 100ms
Must support documents up to 50 pages
Offline mode requires local storage strategy
Export functionality depends on document model being finalized

name: Employee Onboarding Portal
description: Build an employee onboarding portal where HR can create onboarding checklists for new hires. New employees should see their personalized checklist including document uploads, training video completions, policy acknowledgments, and IT setup requests. Include progress tracking for both the new hire and their manager, email reminders for incomplete tasks, and a simple reporting dashboard for HR to monitor onboarding completion rates.
requirements: HR admin panel to create onboarding checklists
Personalized checklist view for new employees
Training video tracking with completion status
Progress tracking for employee and manager
HR reporting dashboard for completion rates
constraints: Document upload must support PDF and images only
Checklist template system must be built before employee portal
Must send reminder emails 3 days before deadline
Must comply with basic data privacy requirements
